description: Search Circuit's paid AI agent skills by capability, e.g. 'phishing link', 'token price' or 'summarize a web page'. Returns each skill's id, price in USDG, summary and 30-day usage. Free.

category.description: Optional category, e.g. Security, On-chain, Developer, Market Data, Research, News.

maxPrice.description: Optional highest price per call in USDG, e.g. 0.005.

query.description: What the skill should do. Leave empty to list everything.
